title: Robots Never Lie
description:
A fictional web application exposes the following `robots.txt` during an authorized lab assessment:

```
User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /backup-2026
Disallow: /vault
Allow: /
```

The lab asks for the most sensitive-looking path that the site author tried to hide.
objective: Submit the hidden vault path as HC{/path}.

hints.text: There are three disallowed paths. One name suggests stored secrets.
